name: WASCO
recent: Wasco 于 2026 年 11 月 20 日宣布拟以 1.928 亿美元（约 7.822 亿令吉）现金将工程与制造部门出售给 NMDC Energy PJSC。公司 2026 财年第三季度净利润同比下降 15%，营收降至五年低点，原因是供应链中断导致项目延迟。此外，公司于 2026 年 8 月宣布每股 3 仙的首次中期股息。
notable: 拟以 1.928 亿美元现金出售工程与制造部门给 NMDC Energy PJSC。

risks: 供应链中断导致项目延迟，影响营收表现。
第三季度营收降至五年低点。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 4.875 亿令吉，环比增长 8.0%，但同比下降 29.7%；净利润为 3144 万令吉，环比增长 183.2%，同比下降 7.4%；净利率为 6.4%，高于上一季度的 2.5%。

recent_en: On 20 November 2026, Wasco announced the proposed disposal of its engineering and fabrication division to NMDC Energy PJSC for USD192.825 million (approximately RM782.2 million) in cash. The company's 3Q FY2026 net profit fell 15% year-on-year as revenue hit a five-year low due to supply-chain disruptions delaying projects. It also declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share in August 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of the engineering and fabrication division to NMDC Energy PJSC for USD192.825 million cash.
3Q FY2026 net profit fell 15% year-on-year as revenue hit a five-year low.
Declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share for FY2026.
risks_en: Supply-chain disruptions have delayed projects, affecting revenue performance.
3Q revenue fell to a five-year low.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM487.5 million, up 8.0% QoQ but down 29.7% YoY; net profit was RM31.4 million, up 183.2% QoQ but down 7.4% YoY; net margin was 6.4%, up from 2.5% in the previous quarter.
